query:
UPDATE pictures
               SET exif_data   = $2,
                   captured_at = $3,
                   gps_lat     = $4,
                   gps_lng     = $5,
                   gps_alt     = $6,
                   gps_accuracy_m = $8,
                   orientation = $7,
                   last_pipeline_run_at = NULL
               WHERE id = $1
